messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] set global thousands seperator for kable
parts:
That is not (yet) possible with knitr::kable(), but I think it should be easy to define your own function to do this, e.g.

format_thou = function(data, cols) {
  if (missing(cols)) {
    cols = NULL
    for (j in 1:ncol(data)) if (is.numeric(data[, j])) cols = c(cols, j)
  }
  if (length(cols))
    data[, cols] = format(data[, cols], big.mark = ',', scientific = FALSE)
  data
}


> dat = as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(20, 1e6, 1e4), 5))
> format_thou(dat)
